infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Safe Alert needs location access to provide emergency services with your exact location during critical situations and to share your location with emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Safe Alert uses location services to provide emergency alerts and share your location with emergency contacts even when the app is in the background for continuous safety monitoring.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Safe Alert needs background location access to provide continuous safety monitoring and emergency location sharing with your emergency contacts.

NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti.EmergencyLocation: Safe Alert needs temporary access to your location to send emergency alerts with your current position to first responders and emergency contacts.

infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Safe Alert sends critical emergency notifications to alert your emergency contacts when you need help. These notifications bypass Do Not Disturb for emergency situations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Safe Alert may record audio during emergency situations for evidence and to help emergency responders understand the situation.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Safe Alert needs access to your contacts to help you quickly add emergency contacts for critical safety notifications.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Safe Alert may use the camera to capture evidence during emergency situations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Safe Alert may save emergency evidence to your photo library for documentation purposes.
